explainer.title: The model is the brain, the agent is the hands
explainer.text: A model writes text. An agent is software that gives a model tools, runs what it asks for, feeds back the results, and loops until the task is done. In a chat, a person reads the answer and decides what to do; with an agent, the software does it.

explainer.title: One model, many agents
explainer.text: The same model can sit behind many agents, and a model and its agent often have different names. Meta's Muse Spark (a model) powers Meta AI (the agent); Claude powers Claude Code and Microsoft's Copilot Cowork; OpenClaw can run Claude, GPT or a local open-weight model. The Runs on column shows which.

explainer.title: Risk follows reach
explainer.text: What an agent can touch matters as much as how capable its model is: files, a terminal, email, other systems. Anything it reads, such as a web page, email or file, can carry hidden instructions (prompt injection).

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.runs_on: Anthropic's Claude models (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku and others)
agents.can_act_on: Files, terminal and shell, code execution, GitHub and GitLab, other tools via MCP connectors
agents.access: Paid Claude plans (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise) and API accounts
agents.security_evidence: Asks permission before changing files or running commands; an automatic mode on most paid plans lets it work longer while still stopping risky commands. Runs locally and calls the model API directly.

agents.name: Claude in Chrome
agents.can_act_on: Web browsing using your own logins: reads pages, clicks, types and fills in forms across tabs
agents.access: All paid Claude plans since 26 Aug 2026; admins can limit it to approved sites
agents.security_evidence: Anthropic reports prompt-injection attacks succeeded 3.8% of the time against Opus 5 before extra safeguards, and none against Sonnet 5, Opus 5 or Mythos 5 with its probes and action classifier (0.3% for Fable 5). These are Anthropic's own figures.

agents.name: OpenAI Codex
agents.maker_note: Desktop app merged into the ChatGPT desktop app in July 2026.
agents.runs_on: OpenAI's GPT models (GPT-6.1 Sol in Codex; GPT-5.5-Cyber for Codex Security)
agents.open_source: Partly (the command-line tool is open source; the app is not)
agents.can_act_on: Files, terminal and shell, code execution in a sandbox, optional internet access, GitHub
agents.security_evidence: In March 2026 researchers found a now-patched flaw where malicious GitHub branch names could inject commands and retrieve GitHub tokens.

agents.name: ChatGPT agent
agents.maker_note: Replaced Operator, which closed on 31 Aug 2025.
agents.runs_on: OpenAI models, starting with its Computer-Using Agent model
agents.can_act_on: Web browsing on its own virtual computer, research, forms, bookings and orders
agents.security_evidence: Asks for confirmation before significant actions, and the user can stop a task at any time.

agents.name: Gemini agent
agents.maker_note: Launched 8 Oct 2026, for businesses first; consumers later.
agents.runs_on: Picks a model per task; users can also choose, including Anthropic's Claude models
agents.can_act_on: Email and its own Workspace account, documents, Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, code repositories, databases, any MCP server
agents.security_evidence: Keeps an audit trail attributed to the agent rather than a person. Google has not published security detail beyond that.

agents.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot (incl. Researcher, Copilot Cowork, Copilot Studio agents)
agents.runs_on: OpenAI's GPT models and Anthropic's Claude models; Researcher uses both, Copilot Cowork runs on Claude
agents.can_act_on: Email, documents, Teams, SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 data; other systems via connectors
agents.access: Microsoft 365 Copilot licences; agent features depend on licence and admin settings

agents.name: GitHub Copilot coding agent
agents.runs_on: A choice of models depending on plan, including premium third-party models
agents.can_act_on: Files, code execution and tests in a temporary cloud environment, one GitHub repository and branch per task; opens pull requests
agents.security_evidence: Sessions last at most 59 minutes and touch one repository; repository rules can block it and owners can switch it off per repository.

agents.name: OpenClaw
agents.maker_note: Formerly Clawdbot and Moltbot. Its creator, Peter Steinberger, joined OpenAI in Feb 2026; the project moved to a foundation and stays open source.
agents.runs_on: Any: Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and Qwen, or local models
agents.can_act_on: Terminal and shell, files, code execution, web browsing, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Teams, Signal and other messaging apps; add-on 'skills' from a public registry
agents.access: Free; self-hosted on your own machine or server
agents.security_evidence: CVE-2026-25253 (CVSS 8.8) let a malicious website hijack the assistant and was exploited in the wild; in late Jan 2026 at least 14 malicious skills were uploaded to its public registry; over 1,800 exposed instances leaked API keys and chat histories.

agents.name: Cursor
agents.maker_note: SpaceX completed its $60bn purchase on 14 Aug 2026. SpaceX also owns xAI.
agents.runs_on: A choice of models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI and Meta, plus Cursor's own Composer
agents.can_act_on: Files, terminal and shell, code execution, other tools via MCP

agents.name: Devin
agents.maker_note: Cognition also owns the Windsurf editor, run as a separate product.
agents.runs_on: Not confirmed: Cognition does not name the models publicly
agents.can_act_on: Its own cloud machine with browser, terminal and editor; GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Linear, Slack, Sentry
agents.access: Paid plans from $20 a month; enterprise options include data residency

agents.name: Manus
agents.maker_note: Meta bought Manus (reported at over $2bn), announced 31 Dec 2025, and still sells it.
agents.can_act_on: Web browsing, research and multi-step tasks

agents.name: Dots
agents.maker_note: Launched at DevDay on 29 Sep 2026; one Dot per user at launch.
agents.can_act_on: Always on: uses a computer and connected apps to research, draft documents and write software; reached through ChatGPT, Slack or Microsoft Teams
agents.access: ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium first; beta for Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare, off unless an admin enables it
agents.security_evidence: Users set boundaries on what a Dot may do on its own; admins control whether it is enabled. OpenAI has published no further security detail.

agents.name: Meta AI (agent features)
agents.maker_note: Agent features rolled out from late July 2026, in selected countries first; WhatsApp to follow.
agents.runs_on: Meta's Muse Spark models (Muse Spark 1.1 at launch)
agents.can_act_on: Your email and calendar, the web, Facebook Marketplace shopping, recurring tasks run without you, documents and slides
agents.access: Public, through the Meta AI app and meta.ai in selected countries
agents.security_evidence: Meta has not detailed how it retains data or controls permissions for email and calendar access. Users can switch to Incognito chats instead.
